The main takeaway from our work is that

we are not only able to isolate pyridoxylated peptides, but we have also shown that we can isolate the same pyridoxyl peptides from the same protein, regardless of the conditions of pyridoxal treatment.
the pyridoxyl peptide is a useful tool for studying the structure of a protein.
it is not always necessary for a protein to have the same catalytic machinery to perform the same function.
